_schema: testId, environment, procedure, expectedResult, observedResult, status, evidenceRef, operatorNotes

automated.procedure: Phase 3.2's compressed 60-minute simulated service (20 compressed cycles) - re-verified unchanged this phase
automated.expectedResult: Bounded queue growth, no stale presentation state, no data loss over the simulated duration
automated.operatorNotes: A compressed simulation is not a substitute for real wall-clock hours - it proves logical stability under repeated cycling only.

realHardwareRequired.procedure: Run CIP continuously on the real target machine for a minimum 2 real wall-clock hours (4 preferred) under realistic simulated-service load, monitoring memory, CPU, database growth, queue growth, audio stability, Whisper stability, presentation stability, event duplication, and UI responsiveness
realHardwareRequired.expectedResult: No unbounded growth, no crash, no stale state, UI remains responsive throughout
realHardwareRequired.operatorNotes: No real machine available in this container to run a genuine multi-hour wall-clock test - a container-based multi-hour run would still only be Environment B/A, not Environment C, even if attempted here.
